checksum_policy: Null means upstream checksum not yet obtained; compute local SHA256 after acquisition and verify publisher checksum if supplied.

papers.notes: src/get_data.py covers first four; traffic sources/preprocessing are documented separately.

datasets: UCI Localization Data for Person Activity

synthetic.method: Graph-based vector autoregressive process; use official script/config for exact coefficients and seeds.
Uniform frequency and phase in [0,0.1], (sin(freq*t+phase)+1)/2, default seed 123; configurations specify sample count/length/dimension.
dm_control suite.load(hopper,stand), uniformly initialized qpos/qvel, physics.step(), 12 qpos/qvel channels, default seed 123; separate from downloaded NRTSI MuJoCo.

papers.notes: Paper Table 11 lists MuJoCo dimension 14 and 10000 samples; current repository generator defaults to 12 dimensions/30000 samples. Match frozen paper/version configuration before regeneration.

synthetic.method: MultivariateDataGenerator, 5 channels alternating sine/cosine, freq .04, coef 1.5, noise_amp .05, training length 20000, test length 5000; 2 rates each for global/contextual/seasonal/shapelet/trend/mixture anomalies. Follow Appendix A.6 parameters; paper excerpt gives no random seed, so newly generated data cannot be asserted byte-identical to released sets.

papers.notes: Paper Section 4.1 names NIPS-TS-GECCO; repository uses NIPS_TS_Water script. Do not confuse with SWaT.
